overall.headline: You have the raw material. The system is missing.
You're in motion. The question is: motion toward what?
You're building. The gap is acceleration.

questions.text: Do you have a primary income source that doesn't require your physical presence?
Have you earned money outside of a traditional salary in the last 12 months?
Do you know exactly what you would sell if you lost your job tomorrow?
Could you double your income without doubling your hours?
Do you have a defined offer with a clear price and delivery structure?
Have you had a paying client in the last 90 days outside of employment?
Do you have a system for generating leads consistently?
Do you know your hourly effective rate across all income sources?
Could you generate £1,000 in 30 days starting from scratch?
Do you have a second income lever active or ready to activate?
Do you track your income weekly?
Have you raised your prices in the last 12 months?
Do you have a sales conversation framework you use consistently?
Do you know which income activity produces the highest return on your time?
Are you actively building toward financial independence?
Do you weigh yourself or track a body metric at least weekly?
Do you follow a structured nutrition approach (not perfect, just structured)?
Have you lost weight or improved a body metric in the last 90 days?
Do you train at least 3x per week consistently?
Do you sleep 7+ hours per night more than 5 days a week?
Do you know your current body fat % or a proxy metric?
Do you have a daily eating structure (not a diet, a structure)?
Has your energy level been consistently above 7/10 this month?
Do you track what you eat at least 4 days a week?
Have you completed a 30+ day consistency streak with any health habit?
Do you have a protocol you follow when you fall off track?
Is your body where you want it to be, or do you have a clear plan to get there?
Do you know how many free hours you have per week to work on new income?
Have you travelled to or lived in a country other than your home country in the last 2 years?
Do you have a morning routine that takes less than 60 minutes and sets up your day?
Is your calendar controlled by you, or by other people's priorities?
Do you have a daily deep work block of 90+ minutes?
Are you living in the city/country you want to be in right now?
Do you have a clear 12-month location plan?
Do you have passive or semi-passive income that runs without your daily attention?
Is your relationship with social media intentional (scheduled, not reactive)?
Do you have a weekly review process?
Do you know what your ideal week looks like in precise detail?
Are you spending time daily on activities that compound over time?
Are you proud of how you spent last week?
